rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides secure access to Atomic CRM data through OAuth 2.1 authentication with Supabase. Enables querying of customer relationship management data including contacts, companies, deals, tasks, and sales pipeline information. Implements Row Level Security enforcement through PostgreSQL session variables, ensuring users can only access data they have permission to view. Features dynamic schema discovery and supports complex SQL queries with JOINs and aggregations for sales analytics and CRM reporting workflows.
